name: Soundscape Mixer
description: A small mixer of weather sounds made on the spot with WebAudio, no files: rain, wind, a stream and a fire, each with a level and a live picture of itself.

props.name: title
props.description: The mixer's name, shown beside the play button.

props.name: sources
props.description: Which sounds the mixer offers, shown in that fixed order.

props.name: defaultLevels
props.description: Starting level of each sound, from 0 to 1.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card. Other section props are passed through.
